steps.content:
September 29, 9:20 PM
Eastside District 14 - Bar

steps.speaker: Disheveled Middle-aged Man
steps.content: ...Snore... ugh... pfff...
Deep at night, in one of Eastside's many bars, a man slumbers away on a long table, mumbling to himself...

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: Hahahaha, out and about town in this condition? You're making a fool of yourself! Hey, wake up! Inspector! Didn't you receive an award on TV just last year?

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: Pioneer of justice... Inspector of courage... Wholeheartedly serving the public... Hey, why don't you show us... just how noble you were back then? Hmm? Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Icebreaker Douchebag
steps.content: Hey, quit mocking him already. His wife ran away and his career went bust. Go comfort him, ahahaha!
The sluggish "inspector" gets pushed a few times, but he doesn't wake up.
The radio nearby begins to broadcast.

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: Hey hey! Thanks for tuning in to DeadLover Radio! Today, we're bringing you a jaw-dropping urban legend from across the Rust! That's right! From the dazzling, glamorous East-side...!

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: In wealthy, idyllic Eastside, where there is no Mania nor unrest, there have been recent sightings of weirdos known as the Sleepwalkers...

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: ...Huh? Sleepwalk...?

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: These dazed Sleepwalkers are like walking oil wells, vomiting black goo as they walk. The goo they spew then turns into hideous monsters...

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: You can't burn them or beat them. The black goo will haunt you forever... They won't awaken or stop. The Sleepwalkers just spew black goo without end...

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: Listen... They're catching up with you... In the lovers' park, at the thronging markets, on the secluded path back home...

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: Hey... Control yourself. People are calling to complain.

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: Ahahah... In any case, if you've ever encountered "that sort of thing", give us a call right away! Love is looking forward to your fun... no, spectacular story!

steps.speaker: DeadLover Radio
steps.content: ——Buzz——Buzz——

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: Hehe... Good show. Who knew there'd be such entertaining DJs in a dump like Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: ...Sleepwalkers... My case... I have to crack this case...

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: What a killjoy. What case? Just listen to the show! You were demoted last week. You're not an inspector anymore.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: I... I'm what?

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: Oh, you're awake?...Argh!

steps.speaker: Blabbermouth Douchebag
steps.content: Argh!
Before he can finish, a punch lands square in his face. His head slams on the table, sending him into terrified silence.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: What did you say I am?

steps.speaker: Icebreaker Douchebag
steps.content: Hey, calm down, calm down.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: **** you... That's... That's my... Humph. MY case... Why aren't I allowed to investigate? I'm the incredible inspector... I... I'm going to crack the case... After I solve it, I...
The incredible inspector slams his fist on the table, scaring everyone around.
He blinks hard, then fumbles out a mobile phone from his pocket. He furiously wipes the vomit from the phone, dials a familiar number, then presses his face against the shattered screen...

steps.speaker: Voice on the phone
steps.content: Buzz... Buzz... The number you have... Buzz... Buzz... dialed... Buzz... Buzz... Cannot be reached... Buzz...
His headache and anxiety put him under a lot of distress. In a stroke of bad timing, another call comes in.

steps.speaker: Secret Telegram
steps.content: Hello, Inspector Doyle. This is the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. About the "Sleepwalkers" case, we'd like you...

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: What **** bureau! I don't care what **** boss of Noms you are! Now listen up! The Sleepwalkers case is mine! Don't stick your ******* nose into this!
With that, he slams down the phone. His whole body spins around from the force of his action, slamming piteously into the edge of the table.
From the other end of the long table, a cold voice speaks up from the shadows.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: All right, calm down. You're startling everyone.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: It's such a lovely evening. Let's cheer up with something sweet. Here, my treat.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: Even though there's only a bit left, I promise you'll like it...
A blurred figure appeared in the shadows as she pushed an eerie glass from the other end of the long table. The tired Inspector snatched the glass of glowing drink, and drank it all down in one go.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: This ****... so sweet. It makes me retch...
His head falls back on the table. Amidst his stupor, he seems to have spotted a long-lost figure.

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: Nasha... You came...

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: Come back. It's all my fault...

steps.speaker: Inspector
steps.content: Nasha...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: ...Hehe. Perfect.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Woman
steps.content: Sweet dreams tonight...
